claim: Complete spectral census of 6-regular circulants on 29 vertices up to isomorphism.

correctness.evidence: Fresh enumeration gave 26 multiplier classes of orbit size 14; independent Fourier spectra reproduced 12/26 two-sided and 20/26 one-sided Ramanujan counts and the stated minimizers; exact charpolys are 26 distinct with coefficient -87.

originality.evidence: Hirano-Katata-Yamasaki gives valency guarantees, not a fixed (29,6) type census; Conde et al. explains prime-order cospectral shape but not this table/ranking. No prior fixed-stratum census was found.

value.evidence: The complete quotient, Ramanujan dichotomy, extremal witness, margins and spectral fingerprints form a reusable benchmark at a natural prime-order fixed stratum.
